name: Caldera Scales
description: Collect heatproof scales from Lava Drakes in the caldera.

dialogue.offer: I can line my shelter against the lava winds with four Drake Scales. The caldera is crawling with them.
dialogue.in_progress: Look near the molten channels, but keep solid ground behind you.
dialogue.ready: These scales are broad enough to cover the whole western wall.
dialogue.completed: For the first time, the caldera wind cannot reach me.
